mapper.sql: id, dev_dept, stat_group, user_id, user_name, position_role, stat_month

FROM ( SELECT id, "部门" AS dev_dept, "统计组" AS stat_group, TRIM("统一认证号") AS user_id, "姓名" AS user_name, "岗位角色" AS position_role, "统计月份" AS stat_month, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY TRIM("统一认证号") ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRIM("有效日期截止") = '9999-12-31' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, NULLIF(TRIM("有效日期截止"), '') DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC ) AS rn FROM developer_pl_person_info_t WHERE "统计月份" = (SELECT MAX("统计月份") FROM developer_pl_person_info_t) AND LENGTH(TRIM("统一认证号")) > 0 ) p WHERE rn = 1
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT dev_dept, stat_group AND LENGTH(TRIM(dev_dept)) > 0 ORDER BY dev_dept, stat_group
SELECT dev_dept, stat_group, user_id, user_name, position_role AND user_id IN #{id} ORDER BY user_id
